title: Scene-thumbnail asset map fragment (spec 243)
description:
Layered overlay enforcing the patternProperties wrapper, ULID key format, and per-entry value shape for per-Scene thumbnail asset entries inside a STAC Item's `assets` map.

This contract is the **planning artefact** that the implementation will deliver as `shared/schemas/contracts/scene-thumbnail-asset.schema.json`. The shipped artefact will replace the inline ULID pattern with a `$ref` to the LinkML-generated SceneThumbnailAssetEntry value shape (single source of truth via Article II); this planning copy inlines the value shape so the contract can be reviewed standalone.

Pair invariant (scene-thumbnail-pair-rule-001) and orphan rule (scene-thumbnail-orphan-rule-001) are enforced by services/stac/src/debrief_stac/scene_thumbnail_audit.py — not by this schema.

^scene-thumbnail-[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26}(.$comment: In the shipped artefact this object is a single $ref to https://debrief.info/schemas/storyboard.schema.json#/$defs/SceneThumbnailAssetEntry. Inlined here for reviewability.

href.description: URI-reference relative to the Item directory; conventionally `./scene-thumbnails/scene-{ULID}.png` (large) or `./scene-thumbnails/scene-{ULID}-sm.png` (small).

type.description: Always `image/png` — Storyboarding capture writes PNGs only.

roles.description: Exactly `["thumbnail"]`. Storyboarding-derived thumbnails are not declared as `overview` (which is reserved for plot-level overviews of dimensions 600×800).

title.description: Optional human label. Storyboarding writer emits `"Scene thumbnail"` (large) or `"Scene thumbnail (small)"` (small).

_validator_notes.$comment: Notes for validator integrators; not enforced.
_validator_notes.ulid_alphabet: Crockford base-32: digits 0-9 + uppercase A-Z minus I, L, O, U.
_validator_notes.key_anchors: Key MUST match the full pattern, not merely a prefix — `^...$` anchors are required so that `scene-thumbnail-foo` (non-ULID suffix) is rejected.
_validator_notes.co_occurrence: This overlay says nothing about plot-level `thumbnail` / `overview` / `features` / `source-*` keys; they are governed by the parent Item shape and may co-exist freely with scene-thumbnail entries.
